props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. Rendered as `aria-label` only when non-empty AND only when the host does not already carry `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, because a consumer's own labelling must never be clobbered by a default.

props.name: max
props.description: The scale the value is measured against. Clamped to 0..max on render.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value. A finite number makes the bar determinate; an absent (or non-finite) value makes it indeterminate — there is no honest percentage to report for a task whose length is unknown, so the contract says the bar sweeps instead of filling.

ai.summary: Shows how far along a task is, or that a task is running with no known end.
whenToUse: Work is in progress and the user is waiting on it
The completion fraction is known and moving
The progress explains why something else on the page is unavailable
whenNotToUse: The operation finished and its result is what matters — use an Alert
A single unmeasured delay is all there is — use a Spinner
It is a placeholder for content that is about to arrive — use a Skeleton
ai.accessibility: `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`, and `aria-valuenow` only when the value is determinate — an indeterminate bar that announced a number would be lying. The bar's width is derived from value over max. The `label` prop becomes `aria-label` only when the consumer set none of its own.
knownLimitations: No percentage text is rendered: formatting a number for the reader's locale is an Intl decision this element does not make
Under reduced motion the indeterminate bar keeps a static partial fill rather than sitting at zero, because an empty track reads as not started rather than unknown
